title: Uncharted Seas
body:
Welcome aboard ! Uncharted Seas offer you many possibilities around ship themed builds, ever wanted to build the titanic ? or any luxurious ocean liner ? now with this mod you can !

Without forgeting some Roleplay stuffs aivable !

Not usable in survival,only for creative uses.

I recommend to use create, create deco and create aeronautic(for moving ship).

This mod is made to work with create and aeronautic.

I will update sometimes this mod to expend furthermore the block collection this mod has.

Enjoy ! and beware of the Icebergs !

Dont forget to report any issue if there is.

Im open to suggestions and ideas.
